title: HHS poverty guidelines (ASPE Poverty Guidelines API: the federal poverty level by year, area and household size)
agency: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of the Assistant Secretary for Planning and Evaluation
questions: the federal poverty level for a family of four in 2025
the income limit at 138 percent of the federal poverty level for Medicaid expansion
how much the poverty guidelines rose from 2015 to 2025
the SNAP gross income limit at 130 percent of poverty by household size
poverty guidelines for Alaska and Hawaii
income at 400 percent of poverty for ACA premium tax credits

manual.how: Open https://aspe.hhs.gov/topics/poverty-economic-mobility/poverty-guidelines (the current year's tables) or Prior HHS Poverty Guidelines and Federal Register References on the same site, copy the guideline for each household size, and record them with write_table as published/<name>.csv naming the page.

cache.why: A new year's guidelines are added each January; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: The poverty guidelines are published by HHS, a U.S. government work in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of the Assistant Secretary for Planning and Evaluation, HHS Poverty Guidelines ({dataset}), aspe.hhs.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which guideline year does the program use? HHS publishes each year's guidelines in January. Medicaid and CHIP use the current year's; ACA premium tax credits use the guidelines of the year before the coverage year; SNAP sets its income limits each October 1 from the guidelines published that January. Default: the year the program rule names, stated in the answer.
Which area? The guidelines for the 48 contiguous states and DC (us) differ from Alaska's and Hawaii's (higher). Default: us, with ak and hi only when the question covers those states.

Guidelines or Census poverty thresholds? The guidelines are the administrative measure for eligibility; the official poverty rate uses the Census Bureau's thresholds (by family size and number of children). Default: guidelines for eligibility and income limits; census for counts of people in poverty.

use_instead.question: People or families in poverty, poverty rates by place or group
use_instead.why: The official poverty rate uses the Census Bureau's poverty thresholds (ACS, CPS ASEC); the guidelines are only income limits.

use_instead.question: Number of people with income below a percent of poverty (eligible population)
use_instead.why: Microdata give income relative to the poverty line person by person; this pack gives the line itself.
